button.name: button_employee_events
button.help: View all RFID access events for this employee including entries, exits, and denials

button.name: button_doors_list
button.title: Accessible doors
button.help: View all doors this employee can access based on their access groups

page.help: Manage RFID access control settings for this employee including cards, PIN codes, and access groups
Manage RFID cards assigned to this employee

list.help: List of all RFID/Barcode cards assigned to this employee. Active cards are shown in green, inactive in red.

field.name: number
field.help: Unique card identifier (hexadecimal format for RFID, numeric for Barcode)

field.name: card_reference
field.help: Optional reference label for easy identification

field.name: activate_on
field.help: Date when this card becomes active (leave empty for immediate activation)

field.name: deactivate_on
field.help: Date when this card expires (leave empty for no expiration)

field.name: card_type
field.help: Type of card: RFID for proximity cards, Barcode for printed badges

field.name: cloud_card
field.help: Enable for virtual/mobile cards that work through cloud services

button.name: generate_random_barcode_card
button.help: Generate a new random barcode card for printing employee badges

page.help: Define which access groups this employee belongs to for door permissions

list.help: Access groups control door permissions and time schedules. Groups are filtered by department.

field.name: access_group_id
field.help: Select an access group available for the employee's department

field.name: activate_on
field.help: Date when this access group membership becomes active

field.name: expiration
field.help: Date when this access group membership expires (leave empty for permanent access)

field.name: state
field.help: Enable/disable this access group membership temporarily
